title: Roberto Carlos Reveals Losing 99% of His Football Earnings
seoTitle: Roberto Carlos Lost 99% of Football Earnings
subtitle: Former Brazilian Full-back Describes Sudden Financial Crisis and Lessons for Young Athletes
excerpt: World Cup winner Roberto Carlos revealed he lost 99% of his football earnings due to issues with agents and family matters, describing a sudden financial crisis.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
During a panel discussion on personal brand and legacy in football, former Brazilian full-back Roberto Carlos revealed that he lost 99% of the money he accumulated throughout his career. The incident reportedly occurred suddenly when he received unknown documents that led him to find his bank account emptied.

Sudden Loss of 99% of Assets

Roberto Carlos explained that, following issues with a former agent and family matters, his bank account was wiped out. He described the situation as a "serious problem" that manifested between Thursday night and Friday morning.

Post-Career Planning from the Start

Even with the crisis, the former player emphasized that he was already preparing for life off the pitch before ending his career. He already held a sports director license and worked with brands, which provided him with a foundation for the transition.

Restructuring with Business Partner Support

To reorganize his financial and family life, Roberto Carlos stated he received assistance from Paul Brighten, his partner at Entourage Sport & Entertainment. Brighten's support enabled the restructuring of his finances and domestic environment.

Warning for Younger Athletes

The former full-back concluded that his experience serves as a warning for young people. He urged athletes to avoid making the same mistakes that led him to lose most of his assets.

Participation in the Portugal Football Summit

The account was shared during a panel on personal brand and legacy in football, alongside Paul Brighten and Bruna Cicolino, from Talent & Influencer Marketing África Creative. The event also featured Júlio César, a former goalkeeper for the Brazilian national team.

Currently a Real Madrid Ambassador

Roberto Carlos, who currently serves as an ambassador for Real Madrid, says he feels at peace sharing his story, presenting both the positive and negative aspects of his journey.

With information from ge, UOL.
